finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Ticket `fwrd70-n1 RD Bench Ticket` created (reference **RD-1015**, customer "Bench Test Co", raised 2026-09-17), confirmed in the tickets list and detail view.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Part `fwrd70-n1 RD Part A` (cost $100.00, markup 25%, qty 1) computed **price $125.00**.

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Part `fwrd70-n1 RD Part B` (cost $200.00, markup 25%, qty 1) computed **price $250.00** (parts total at that point: $375.00).

**Objective 4 — DONE.** After editing Part A's cost from 100 to 150 (markup 25%), the app recomputed its price to **$187.50**; ticket parts total became $437.50.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Ticket status is **Ready**. The precondition discovery result: the app did **not** block the transition — clicking "Mark Ready" was accepted on the first attempt with no error or message. The ticket already had a customer and two saved parts, so whatever the app's preconditions for Ready are (at minimum a customer; the parts were present), they were already satisfied. Status verified via explicit wait (text_equals) and a fresh page navigation, both reading "Ready".

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Both parts were deleted (each via the row's Delete button plus an in-page "Confirm / Delete part" dialog, both accepted; the table settled to "No parts on this ticket yet."). The ticket was then archived via "Archive ticket" (applied immediately, no precondition; an "Archived" badge appeared and the button became "Unarchive ticket"). Final verification: the active tickets list (Showing 1–10 of 13) no longer contains RD-1015; with "Show archived" checked it appears as `RD-1015 | fwrd70-n1 RD Bench Ticket Archived | Bench Test Co | Ready | 0 | 2026-09-17` — i.e. 0 parts, nothing from this run left active.
